dungeons.name: Hall of Thanes
dungeons.description: Someone has broken into the royal dwarven burial chamber beneath Ironforge.

dungeons.name: Ragefire Chasm
dungeons.description: Troggs and Burning Blade cultists infest the molten caverns beneath Orgrimmar.

dungeons.name: Ruins of Lordaeron
dungeons.description: Scourge forces still haunt the ruined capital while a necromancer gathers power within the city.

bosses.name: Lordaeron Captain
bosses.description: Rare spawn. Friendly to the Alliance: only the Horde can kill him.

trash.name: Death Bindings
trash.from: Skeleton / Skeletal Soldier / Skeletal Mage / Fallen Necromancer

dungeons.name: The Deadmines
dungeons.description: The Defias Brotherhood is building a warship in the mines beneath Moonbrook.

bosses.name: Miner Johnson
bosses.description: Rare spawn in the side passage after Rhahk'Zor.

dungeons.name: Wailing Caverns
dungeons.description: Deep beneath the Barrens, druids and fanglords guard the sleeping Naralex while twisted beasts prowl the caverns.

bosses.name: Deviate Faerie Dragon
bosses.description: Rare spawn.

dungeons.name: Shadowfang Keep
dungeons.description: Archmage Arugal and his worgen followers hold the keep above Pyrewood Village.

bosses.name: Deathsworn Captain
bosses.description: Rare spawn.

dungeons.name: Blackfathom Deeps
dungeons.description: A flooded night elf ruin on the Zoram Strand, occupied by naga, murlocs and Twilight's Hammer cultists serving Aku'mai.

dungeons.name: Excavation Site: Wetlands
dungeons.description: A Titan dig site trapped in time above Whelgar's Excavation, where errant Titan constructs have stopped obeying anyone. Areas inside: Lost Marsh, Stalker's Thicket, Site of the Guardian and Lost Dig Site.

bosses.name: Saltspine
bosses.description: A white crocolisk.

bosses.name: Shadetooth
bosses.description: A giant violet raptor, leader of the Thicket raptors.

bosses.name: Relic Guardian
bosses.description: Final boss: a stone Titan construct.

trash.name: Unearthed Barrier
trash.from: Highland Lurker / Marsh Crocolisk / Highland Spider

trash.name: Ancient Cleaver
trash.from: Highland Lurker / Thicket Hunter / Highland Spider

trash.name: Mark of the Marsh
trash.from: Marsh Skulker / Marsh Crocolisk / Thicket Hunter

trash.name: Thicket Bindings
trash.from: Thicket Matriarch / Highland Lurker / Thicket Hunter

trash.name: Abandoned Leggings
trash.from: Highland Spider / Thicket Lurker / Young Riptooth

trash.name: Excavated Dagger
trash.from: Highland Snapper / Highland Spider / Thicket Lurker

dungeons.name: The Stockade
dungeons.description: Defias prisoners have overrun Stormwind's prison beneath the Canal District.

bosses.name: Bruegal Ironknuckle
bosses.description: Rare spawn.

dungeons.name: City of Dalaran
dungeons.description: The restored mage city of Dalaran has become a new five-player dungeon in WoW Forever. Enter through the sewers and the Underbelly, then fight through the streets to the Violet Citadel.

bosses.name: Atrexis the Grave Knight
bosses.description: At the ritual circle in the Underbelly, surrounded by Kirin Tor Necromancers and rising skeletons. Disarms.

bosses.name: Arcane Anomaly
bosses.description: On a round terrace in the streets after leaving the sewers. Casts Arcane Bolt and Focal Blast.

bosses.name: Fel Ancient
bosses.description: A fel-touched treant in the streets, among Suffused Treants.

bosses.name: Unstable Sentinel
bosses.description: An arcane golem by the Magus Commerce Exchange, with Angry Tomes. Malfunction hits everyone within 25 yards.

bosses.name: Lyn the Ignored
bosses.description: Rare elite.

bosses.name: Shade of the Archmage
bosses.description: Final boss, in the Purple Parlor of the Violet Citadel. Don't stand in line with the Bounding Mana target; he polymorphs the group and resets if someone leaves the room.

trash.name: Arcane Remnant Leggings
trash.from: Dark Caster / Saturated Remnant / Mindless Horror

trash.name: Roused Nature Footwraps
trash.from: Saturated Remnant / Fallen Mage / Seeking Remnant

trash.name: Tattered Kirin Tor Cloak
trash.from: Mana Stalker / Dark Caster / Arcane Echo

trash.name: City Guard's Tarnished Blade
trash.from: Mana Echo / Dark Caster / Kirin Tor Necromancer

dungeons.name: Gnomeregan
dungeons.description: The irradiated underground city of the gnomes, overrun by troggs and Mekgineer Thermaplugg's forces.

bosses.name: Grubbis
bosses.description: With his pet Chomper, in the trogg cave off the outer ring.

bosses.name: Viscous Fallout
bosses.description: An irradiated ooze in the Hall of Gears.

bosses.name: Electrocutioner 6000
bosses.description: In the Engineering Labs. Drops the Workshop Key.

bosses.name: Crowd Pummeler 9-60
bosses.description: In the Launch Bay arena.

bosses.name: Mekgineer Thermaplugg
bosses.description: Final boss, in Tinkers' Court. Hit the bomb-face buttons to stop the walking bombs.

bosses.name: Dark Iron Ambassador
bosses.description: Rare spawn among the Dark Iron agents.

dungeons.name: Razorfen Kraul
dungeons.description: A sprawling thorn maze occupied by the quilboar of Razorfen Kraul.

bosses.name: Roogug
bosses.description: A quilboar geomancer near the start of the Kraul.

bosses.name: Charlga Razorflank
bosses.description: Final boss, deep in the Kraul.

bosses.name: Blind Hunter
bosses.description: Rare spawn in the bat caves.

bosses.name: Earthcaller Halmgar
bosses.description: Rare spawn.

dungeons.name: Scarlet Monastery: Graveyard
dungeons.description: The graveyard wing of the Scarlet Monastery, haunted by restless dead and Scarlet defenders.

bosses.name: Interrogator Vishas
bosses.description: In the Chamber of Atonement. Drops Vorrel's Wedding Ring for Vorrel's Revenge.

bosses.name: Azshir the Sleepless
bosses.description: Rare spawn.

bosses.name: Fallen Champion
bosses.description: Rare spawn.

bosses.name: Ironspine
bosses.description: Rare spawn.

bosses.name: Bloodmage Thalnos
bosses.description: Final boss, in Honor's Tomb.

trash.name: Scarlet Wristguards
trash.from: Scarlet Monastery trash (Chain of the Scarlet Crusade)

trash.name: Scarlet Boots
trash.from: Scarlet Monastery trash (Chain of the Scarlet Crusade)

dungeons.name: Scarlet Monastery: Library
dungeons.description: The library wing of the Scarlet Monastery, home to the Houndmaster's kennels and Arcanist Doan's athenaeum.

bosses.name: Houndmaster Loksey
bosses.description: In the Huntsman's Cloister.

bosses.name: Arcanist Doan
bosses.description: Final boss, in the Athenaeum. Doan's Strongbox behind him holds The Scarlet Key.

trash.name: Scarlet Boots
trash.from: Scarlet Monastery trash (Chain of the Scarlet Crusade)

trash.name: Tainted Pierce
trash.from: Scarlet Gallant / Scarlet Beastmaster / Scarlet Monk

trash.name: Swampchill Fetish
trash.from: Arcanist Doan / Scarlet Diviner / Scarlet Monk

dungeons.name: The Drowned City
dungeons.description: I'lalai, a lost Gurubashi troll city, has risen from the sea off the coast of Stranglethorn Vale, west of Grom'gol. Trolls and naga roam the streets of this open-air dungeon, a pirate ship lies wrecked nearby, and the weather builds into a full storm before the final fight. Dive underwater to find the entrance.

bosses.name: Zul'Alai
bosses.description: First boss, an undead troll. Enrages near death and hits the whole group hard.

bosses.name: Var'Taka
bosses.description: Leader of the naga; the Horde quest The Only Good Brinescale... asks for his death. BlizzCon previews called the second boss Zin'aka.

bosses.name: Deathless Marrow
bosses.description: Fought together with a Primeval Elemental.

bosses.name: Min'loth the Serpent
bosses.description: Final boss: the Gurubashi witch doctor Min'loth, whose seat of power was I'lalai.

trash.name: Sword of Dismemberment
trash.from: Risen Sentry / Champion of the Deep / Brinescale Sorceress / Makrura Snapper

dungeons.name: Scarlet Monastery: Armory
dungeons.description: The armory wing of the Scarlet Monastery, where the Crusade drills its recruits under the eye of Herod, the Scarlet Champion. The door is locked: you need The Scarlet Key from the Library.

bosses.name: Herod
bosses.description: Final boss, in the Hall of Champions. When he dies a wave of Scarlet Trainees rushes in.

trash.name: Scarlet Boots
trash.from: Scarlet Monastery trash (Chain of the Scarlet Crusade)

trash.name: Beguiler Robes
trash.from: Scarlet Soldier / Scarlet Defender / Scarlet Myrmidon

trash.name: Chesterfall Musket
trash.from: Scarlet Soldier / Scarlet Defender / Scarlet Guardsman

trash.name: Fight Club
trash.from: Scarlet Myrmidon / Scarlet Protector / Scarlet Soldier

trash.name: Ruthless Shiv
trash.from: Scarlet Soldier / Scarlet Guardsman / Scarlet Defender

trash.name: Archon Chestpiece
trash.from: Scarlet Myrmidon / Scarlet Defender / Scarlet Soldier

trash.name: Warchief Kilt
trash.from: Scarlet Myrmidon / Scarlet Protector / Scarlet Guardsman

dungeons.name: Scarlet Monastery: Cathedral
dungeons.description: The heart of the Scarlet Monastery: the Chapel Gardens and the Crusader's Chapel, held by Scarlet Commander Mograine and High Inquisitor Whitemane. The door is locked: you need The Scarlet Key from the Library.

bosses.name: High Inquisitor Fairbanks
bosses.description: Hidden behind the altar room, through the door at the back of the chapel.

bosses.name: Scarlet Commander Mograine
bosses.description: At the altar of the Crusader's Chapel. Whitemane comes to raise him when he falls.

bosses.name: High Inquisitor Whitemane
bosses.description: Final boss. Comes out of the back room when Mograine dies and resurrects him.

trash.name: Scarlet Boots
trash.from: Scarlet Monastery trash (Chain of the Scarlet Crusade)

trash.name: Flintrock Shoulders
trash.from: Scarlet Centurion / Scarlet Myrmidon / Scarlet Chaplain

dungeons.name: Razorfen Downs
dungeons.description: The ancient burial grounds of the quilboar, now held by the Scourge. Amnennar the Coldbringer leads the undead from the top of the Downs.

bosses.name: Tuten'kash
bosses.description: Spider boss. Ring the gong on the Spiral of Thorns to summon him.

bosses.name: Mordresh Fire Eye
bosses.description: In the room with the bone pile and the floating skulls.

bosses.name: Glutton
bosses.description: On the path up the Downs, after Mordresh.

bosses.name: Ragglesnout
bosses.description: Rare spawn, near the top of the Downs.

bosses.name: Amnennar the Coldbringer
bosses.description: Final boss, at the top of the Downs. Drops the Skull of the Coldbringer for Bring the End.

dungeons.name: Krol'dok Stronghold
dungeons.description: Ogre outrunners have been kidnapping travelers and raiding settlements across the Riverglades. Their trail leads to a fortress of workshops, encampments and guarded inner passages, where strange chanting is heard after nightfall.

bosses.name: Kroog
bosses.description: Rare spawn.

dungeons.name: Uldaman
dungeons.description: An ancient titan vault buried beneath the Badlands, overrun by troggs and Shadowforge dwarves. Archaedas guards the Discs of Norgannon in its deepest chamber.

bosses.name: Revelosh
bosses.description: In the cave before Ironaya's chamber. Drops The Shaft of Tsol for Staff of Prehistoria.

bosses.name: The Lost Dwarves
bosses.description: Baelog, Eric "The Swift" and Olaf, fought together in Dig Two. Horde only: they are friendly to the Alliance.

bosses.name: Ironaya
bosses.description: In the Map Chamber. Use the Staff of Prehistoria on the altar to open her door.

bosses.name: Obsidian Sentinel
bosses.description: Level 42 mechanical guardian near the back entrance to Uldaman, after Ironaya. Drops the Obsidian Power Source for the Mage quest Power in Uldaman.

bosses.name: Ancient Stone Keeper
bosses.description: In the Temple Hall.

bosses.name: Galgann Firehammer
bosses.description: In the Dig Three area, past the Shadowforge dwarves.

bosses.name: Grimlok
bosses.description: Trogg leader in the Stone Vault. Drops the sapphire for the necklace quests.

bosses.name: Archaedas
bosses.description: Final boss, in the Chamber of Khaz'Mul. Use the altar to wake him. Drops the power source for the necklace quests.

dungeons.name: Zul'Farrak
dungeons.description: The sun-baked troll city in the deserts of Tanaris, home of the Sandfury tribe and their chief, Ukorz Sandscalp.

bosses.name: Theka the Martyr
bosses.description: Undead Sandfury boss. Drops the First Mosh'aru Tablet for The Prophecy of Mosh'aru.

bosses.name: Antu'sul
bosses.description: In the basilisk pit at Sul'lithuz Sandcrawlers. Kill his servants when he calls them.

bosses.name: Witch Doctor Zum'rah
bosses.description: In the graveyard. Zombies rise from the graves when he is pulled.

bosses.name: Nekrum Gutchewer
bosses.description: Encountered alongside Shadowpriest Sezz'ziz during the Zul'Farrak pyramid event. Also drops Nekrum's Medallion for the Alliance quest.

bosses.name: Shadowpriest Sezz'ziz
bosses.description: At the top of the pyramid, after the Sergeant Bly event.

bosses.name: Sergeant Bly
bosses.description: After the pyramid event, speak to Weegli Blastfuse to open the gate, then confront Bly about the Divino-matic Rod to fight him and his companions. Drops the rod for the Divino-matic Rod quest.

bosses.name: Hydromancer Velratha
bosses.description: Patrols near the pool and the Gong of Zul'Farrak. Drops the Tiara of the Deep and Second Mosh'aru Tablet for their quests.

bosses.name: Gahz'rilla
bosses.description: Summoned at the Gong of Zul'Farrak with the Mallet of Zul'Farrak. Drops the Electrified Scale for Gahz'rilla.

bosses.name: Zerillis
bosses.description: Rare spawn, patrols the sand dunes outside the temple.

bosses.name: Sandarr Dunereaver
bosses.description: Rare spawn, on the sand dunes outside the temple.

bosses.name: Dustwraith
bosses.description: Rare spawn, near the top of the pyramid.

bosses.name: Ruuzlu
bosses.description: Fought together with Chief Ukorz Sandscalp, on the top of the temple.

bosses.name: Chief Ukorz Sandscalp
bosses.description: Final boss, on the top of the temple. One fight together with Ruuzlu.

dungeons.name: Maraudon
dungeons.description: The sacred caverns of the centaur in Desolace, where Princess Theradras and her corrupted earth elementals rule beneath Zaetar's grave. The orange and purple wings lead to the inner caves; the Scepter of Celebras opens the shortcut to the waterfall.

bosses.name: Noxxion
bosses.description: Orange (Vyletongue) wing. Drops the Celebrian Rod.

bosses.name: Razorlash
bosses.description: Orange wing, patrolling near Noxxion.

bosses.name: Lord Vyletongue
bosses.description: Purple wing. Drops the Celebrian Diamond.

bosses.name: Meshlok the Harvester
bosses.description: Rare spawn in the purple wing.

bosses.name: Celebras the Cursed
bosses.description: In the Wicked Grotto. After he dies, Celebras the Redeemed starts The Scepter of Celebras.

bosses.name: Landslide
bosses.description: In the Foulspore Cavern, past Celebras.

bosses.name: Tinkerer Gizlock
bosses.description: Goblin engineer in the Foulspore Cavern.

bosses.name: Rotgrip
bosses.description: Crocolisk in the waterfall cave below Princess Theradras.

bosses.name: Princess Theradras
bosses.description: Final boss, in the Earth Song Falls. Zaetar's Spirit appears after her death.

dungeons.name: Alcaz Prison
dungeons.description: Long rumored to hold high-ranking prisoners, including King Varian Wrynn, the prison on Alcaz Island has been out of reach until now. Inside, the Defias Brotherhood and the naga are at war.

dungeons.name: Sunken Temple
dungeons.description: The Temple of Atal'Hakkar, sunk beneath the Pool of Tears in the Swamp of Sorrows. The Atal'ai trolls try to summon their blood god Hakkar here, while the green dragons of Eranikus guard the lower halls.

bosses.name: Altar Bosses
bosses.description: The six Atal'ai troll guardians on the balconies round the ring: Gasher, Hukku, Loro, Mijan, Zolo and Zul'Lor. All six must die before Jammal'an the Prophet comes down. They share one loot table.

bosses.name: Gasher
bosses.description: One of the six Atal'ai troll guardians (Altar Bosses) on the balconies round the ring.

bosses.name: Hukku
bosses.description: One of the six Atal'ai troll guardians (Altar Bosses) on the balconies round the ring.

bosses.name: Loro
bosses.description: One of the six Atal'ai troll guardians (Altar Bosses) on the balconies round the ring.

bosses.name: Mijan
bosses.description: One of the six Atal'ai troll guardians (Altar Bosses) on the balconies round the ring.

bosses.name: Zolo
bosses.description: One of the six Atal'ai troll guardians (Altar Bosses) on the balconies round the ring.

bosses.name: Zul'Lor
bosses.description: One of the six Atal'ai troll guardians (Altar Bosses) on the balconies round the ring.

bosses.name: Atal'alarion
bosses.description: Summoned in the statue circle on the upper level (Secret of the Circle).

bosses.name: Morphaz & Hazzas
bosses.description: Two green dragons guarding the temple. Both must be defeated to complete the encounter. Morphaz also drops items for the hunter, rogue, priest and mage class quests.

bosses.name: Jammal'an the Prophet
bosses.description: Fought together with Ogom the Wretched, after the six troll minibosses on the balconies are dead. Drops the Head of Jammal'an.

bosses.name: Ogom the Wretched
bosses.description: Fights beside Jammal'an the Prophet.

bosses.name: Dreamscythe & Weaver
bosses.description: Two green dragons encountered after Jammal'an the Prophet. Both must be defeated to complete the encounter.

bosses.name: Shade of Eranikus
bosses.description: Final boss, in his lair at the bottom of the temple. Drops the Essence of Eranikus.

bosses.name: Avatar of Hakkar
bosses.description: Summoned at the central altar with the Filled Egg of Hakkar (The God Hakkar).

dungeons.name: Blackrock Depths
dungeons.description: The capital of the Dark Iron dwarves beneath Blackrock Mountain: the Detention Block, the Ring of Law, the Grim Guzzler and Shadowforge City, ruled by Emperor Dagran Thaurissan.

bosses.name: High Interrogator Gerstahn
bosses.description: Detention Block. Drops the Prison Cell Key.

bosses.name: Lord Roccor
bosses.description: Earth elemental on the ring above the Detention Block.

loot.name: Formula: Smoking Heart of the Mountain

bosses.name: Houndmaster Grebmar
bosses.description: Kennel master with his hounds on the ring above the Detention Block.

bosses.name: Gorosh the Dervish
bosses.description: Ring of Law: one of six possible challengers.

bosses.name: Grizzle
bosses.description: Ring of Law: one of six possible challengers.

bosses.name: Eviscerator
bosses.description: Ring of Law: one of six possible challengers.

bosses.name: Ok'thor the Breaker
bosses.description: Ring of Law: one of six possible challengers.

bosses.name: Anub'shiah
bosses.description: Ring of Law: one of six possible challengers.

bosses.name: Hedrum the Creeper
bosses.description: Ring of Law: one of six possible challengers.

bosses.name: Theldren
bosses.description: Ring of Law: use the Banner of Provocation in the arena to challenge him and his gladiators. Lefty's Brass Knuckle and Malgen's Long Bow come from the Arena Spoils chest after the fight.

bosses.name: Pyromancer Loregrain
bosses.description: Shrine of Thaurissan, behind the Ring of Law.

bosses.name: Fineous Darkvire
bosses.description: Hall of Crafting. Drops Ironfel for Dark Iron Legacy.

bosses.name: Warder Stilgiss
bosses.description: In the vault with his pet Verek, after the six Dark Keepers.

bosses.name: Lord Incendius
bosses.description: The Black Anvil in the Black Forge.

bosses.name: Bael'Gar
bosses.description: Fire giant at the end of the Dark Iron Highway.

bosses.name: General Angerforge
bosses.description: West Garrison; calls for help at low health.

bosses.name: Golem Lord Argelmach
bosses.description: Manufactory, north of the West Garrison.

bosses.name: Hurley Blackbreath
bosses.description: Grim Guzzler: break the Thunderbrew kegs to make him appear.

bosses.name: Phalanx
bosses.description: Comes to life at the Grim Guzzler door after Hurley or the bar fight.

bosses.name: Ribbly Screwspigot
bosses.description: Grim Guzzler. Kill him for Yuka Screwspigot's bounty.

bosses.name: Plugger Spazzring
bosses.description: Grim Guzzler barkeep; turns hostile if you steal his ale.

bosses.name: Ambassador Flamelash
bosses.description: Chamber of Enchantment; keep the Burning Spirits off him.

bosses.name: Panzor the Invincible
bosses.description: Rare golem that can replace the guards around the West Garrison.

bosses.name: The Seven
bosses.description: Summoners' Tomb: talk to Doom'rel and defeat the seven dwarf spirits one after another. Loot is in the Chest of The Seven.

bosses.name: Magmus
bosses.description: Guards the door to the Imperial Seat; the braziers shoot fire while he lives.

bosses.name: Princess Moira Bronzebeard
bosses.description: Heals the Emperor. Don't kill her if you are on the Royal Rescue or Fate of the Kingdom quest.

bosses.name: Emperor Dagran Thaurissan
bosses.description: Final boss, on the throne of the Imperial Seat.

dungeons.name: Lower Blackrock Spire
dungeons.description: The lower halls of Blackrock Spire, held by the Spirestone, Smolderthorn and Bloodaxe clans of the Dark Horde under Overlord Wyrmthalak.

bosses.name: Spirestone Butcher
bosses.description: Rare ogre in the Spirestone area before Highlord Omokk.

bosses.name: Spirestone Battle Lord
bosses.description: Rare ogre near Highlord Omokk.

bosses.name: Spirestone Lord Magus
bosses.description: Rare ogre caster near Highlord Omokk.

bosses.name: Highlord Omokk
bosses.description: Spirestone ogre chief on the ledge in Hordemar City. Drops the Gemstone of Spirestone.

bosses.name: Shadow Hunter Vosh'gajin
bosses.description: Smolderthorn troll shadow hunter on the way to Voone.

bosses.name: War Master Voone
bosses.description: Smolderthorn troll leader in Mok'Doom. Drops the Gemstone of Smolderthorn.

bosses.name: Mor Grayhoof
bosses.description: Summoned in War Master Voone's room with the Brazier from the Dungeon Set 2 quests: one of the four bosses that drop a piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet.

bosses.name: Mother Smolderweb
bosses.description: Spider queen in the Skitterweb Tunnels. Get poisoned for Mother's Milk.

loot.name: Formula: Dormant Heart of the Mountain

bosses.name: Crystal Fang
bosses.description: Rare spider in the Skitterweb Tunnels.

bosses.name: Urok Doomhowl
bosses.description: Summoned at his pike with Warosh's quest items, along with waves of ogres.

bosses.name: Bannok Grimaxe
bosses.description: Rare Firebrand champion near the Storehouse.

bosses.name: Burning Felguard
bosses.description: Rare demon: Scarshield Warlocks can summon it through their portals.

bosses.name: Quartermaster Zigris
bosses.description: In the Storehouse, guarded by Bloodaxe ogres.

bosses.name: Halycon
bosses.description: Bloodaxe worg pack mistress in her den. Gizrul comes out after she dies.

bosses.name: Gizrul the Slavener
bosses.description: Comes for you shortly after Halycon dies.

bosses.name: Ghok Bashguud
bosses.description: Rare Bloodaxe champion on the bridge to Wyrmthalak.

bosses.name: Overlord Wyrmthalak
bosses.description: Final boss: Bloodaxe overlord in the Chamber of Battle; calls two Bloodaxe Veterans at low health. Drops the Gemstone of Bloodaxe.

dungeons.name: Upper Blackrock Spire
dungeons.description: The top of Blackrock Spire, held by Rend Blackhand's Dark Horde and General Drakkisath's black dragonflight. The door needs the Seal of Ascension.

bosses.name: Pyroguard Emberseer
bosses.description: Hall of Binding: use the altar to wake him once the Blackhand Incarcerators are dead.

loot.name: Formula: Molten Heart of the Mountain

bosses.name: Solakar Flamewreath
bosses.description: The Rookery: touch the Father Flame and fight off the whelp waves until he arrives.

bosses.name: Jed Runewatcher
bosses.description: Rare: sometimes waits in the hall before the Blackrock Stadium.

bosses.name: Goraluk Anvilcrack
bosses.description: Dark Horde blacksmith. Use the Blood Stained Pike on him for The Demon Forge.

bosses.name: Gyth
bosses.description: Blackrock Stadium: Rend's black dragon, released after the arena waves.

bosses.name: Warchief Rend Blackhand
bosses.description: Rides Gyth into the Blackrock Stadium and jumps off when the dragon is low.

bosses.name: The Beast
bosses.description: Giant core hound in its den past the Stadium. Fights back with fireballs and fear.

bosses.name: Lord Valthalak
bosses.description: Summoned with the Brazier of Beckoning from the Dungeon Set 2 quests.

bosses.name: General Drakkisath
bosses.description: Final boss, in the throne room with his two Chromatic Elite Guards. Guards Drakkisath's Brand.

dungeons.name: Dire Maul: East
dungeons.description: The eastern quarter of the ruined Highborne city of Eldre'Thalas, overgrown by the Warpwood and ruled by the satyr Alzzin the Wildshaper. Pusillin carries the Crescent Key that opens the other wings.

bosses.name: Pusillin
bosses.description: The imp you chase through the Warpwood Quarter; he fights at the end and drops the Crescent Key.

bosses.name: Zevrim Thornhoof
bosses.description: Satyr at the sacrificial altar in the Warpwood Quarter.

bosses.name: Hydrospawn
bosses.description: Water elemental in the pool below the bridge.

bosses.name: Lethtendris
bosses.description: Blood elf with her pet Pimgib, in the room before Alzzin. Drops Lethtendris's Web.

bosses.name: Alzzin the Wildshaper
bosses.description: Final boss, deep in the Warpwood Quarter.

dungeons.name: Dire Maul: West
dungeons.description: The Capital Gardens and the Court of the Highborne, where the last Shen'dralar keep the demon Immol'thar imprisoned behind five pylons. Needs the Crescent Key from Pusillin.

bosses.name: Tendris Warpwood
bosses.description: Treant guarding the Capital Gardens.

bosses.name: Tsu'zee
bosses.description: Rare spawn, stealthed in the Capital Gardens.

bosses.name: Magister Kalendris
bosses.description: Shadow priest on the pylon terraces.

bosses.name: Illyanna Ravenoak
bosses.description: Hunter with her bear Ferra, on the pylon terraces.

bosses.name: Immol'thar
bosses.description: Demon in the Prison of Immol'thar; the force field drops once all five pylons are shut down.

bosses.name: Lord Hel'nurath
bosses.description: Summoned by warlocks in the pentagram near Immol'thar (Dreadsteed of Xoroth).

bosses.name: Prince Tortheldrin
bosses.description: Final boss, in the Athenaeum. Drops the Gauntlet of Gordok Might for Unfinished Gordok Business.

trash.name: Wand of Arcane Potency
trash.from: Mana Remnant / Arcane Aberration / Arcane Torrent / Residual Monstrosity

dungeons.name: Dire Maul: North
dungeons.description: Gordok Commons, the ogre-held northern wing. Kill King Gordok to become the new king; leave the guards alive (the Tribute Run) for a bigger tribute chest.

bosses.name: Guard Mol'dar
bosses.description: Ogre guard at the entrance of Gordok Commons.

bosses.name: Stomper Kreeg
bosses.description: Drunk ogre brewer; after the Tribute Run he sells the Gordok brews.

bosses.name: Guard Fengus
bosses.description: Ogre guard in the courtyard.

bosses.name: Guard Slip'kik
bosses.description: Ogre guard behind the trap; the Gordok Ogre Suit lets you walk past him.

bosses.name: Captain Kromcrush
bosses.description: Gives Unfinished Gordok Business; with the Ogre Suit you can talk to him instead of fighting.

bosses.name: Cho'Rush the Observer
bosses.description: Ogre mage fought together with King Gordok.

bosses.name: King Gordok
bosses.description: Final boss. Killing him makes you the new Gordok king and opens the tribute chest.

dungeons.name: Blackmaw Hold
dungeons.description: Beyond a long-sealed gate in Azshara lies the furbolg city of the Blackmaw clan, fighting a corruption that spreads through its groves and mountain tunnels. A large max-level dungeon with several routes and bosses; its depths may lead even farther below Azeroth.

bosses.name: Moontouched Wanderer
bosses.description: Rare spawn.

bosses.name: Gortek the Apprentice
bosses.description: Rare spawn.

bosses.name: Tunnelweb Matriarch
bosses.description: Rare spawn.

trash.name: Furbolg Berserker's Boots
trash.from: Blackmaw Devotee / Blackmaw Berserker / Legashi Slayer

dungeons.name: Stratholme: Living
dungeons.description: The main gate of Stratholme: the burning streets, the Scarlet Bastion and the Hall of Lights, where Grand Crusader Dathrohan reveals himself as the dreadlord Balnazzar.

bosses.name: Skul
bosses.description: Rare spawn near the entrance.

bosses.name: Hearthsinger Forresten
bosses.description: Rare spawn in one of the houses on Festival Lane.

bosses.name: The Unforgiven
bosses.description: Ghost in the square past the gate, surrounded by spectral citizens.

bosses.name: Timmy the Cruel
bosses.description: Appears in Crusaders' Square once the Scourge there are cleared.

bosses.name: Malor the Zealous
bosses.description: In the Scarlet Bastion, past Timmy. Optional: next to him stands Malor's Strongbox with the Medallion of Faith for The Medallion of Faith (Aurius, at the start of the Undead side).

bosses.name: Postmaster Malown
bosses.description: Summoned by opening the three mailboxes with the Key to the City.

bosses.name: Ezra Grimm
bosses.description: The smoke shop's keeper. Clear the shop and touch the box of tobacco, and he comes for it (The Great Fras Siabi).

bosses.name: Cannon Master Willey
bosses.description: On Market Row, in front of the Scarlet Bastion.

bosses.name: Archivist Galford
bosses.description: In the Scarlet Archive; burn the archive afterwards (The Archivist).

bosses.name: Balnazzar
bosses.description: Final boss: Grand Crusader Dathrohan in the Hall of Lights turns into the dreadlord Balnazzar. Drops the Head of Balnazzar.

bosses.name: Jarien and Sothos
bosses.description: Summoned in Balnazzar's chamber, after the last boss, with the Brazier from the Dungeon Set 2 quests: they drop the pieces of Lord Valthalak's Amulet, and their loot is in the chest they leave.

trash.name: Magister's Belt
trash.from: Crimson Conjuror / Crimson Sorcerer / Crimson Battle Mage

trash.name: Devout Bracers
trash.from: Crimson Conjuror / Crimson Initiate / Crimson Priest

trash.name: Wildheart Bracers
trash.from: Crimson Inquisitor / Shrieking Banshee / Wailing Banshee

trash.name: Beaststalker's Bindings
trash.from: Crimson Defender / Ghoul Ravener / Fleshflayer Ghoul

trash.name: Lightforge Belt
trash.from: Crimson Guardsman / Crimson Gallant / Rockwing Gargoyle / Rockwing Screecher

dungeons.name: Stratholme: Undead
dungeons.description: The service entrance side of Stratholme, held by the Scourge: the three ziggurats, the Slaughter House and Baron Rivendare's stronghold. Kill the Baron within 45 minutes to save Ysida Harmon.

bosses.name: Stonespine
bosses.description: Rare gargoyle near the start of the Undead side.

bosses.name: Nerub'enkan
bosses.description: Crypt lord in one of the three ziggurats.

bosses.name: Baroness Anastari
bosses.description: Banshee in one of the three ziggurats; she mind-controls players.

bosses.name: Maleki the Pallid
bosses.description: Lich in one of the three ziggurats.

bosses.name: Magistrate Barthilas
bosses.description: Runs from Elders' Square to the gate of the Baron's stronghold; kill him before the timer if you go for Ysida.

bosses.name: Ramstein the Gorger
bosses.description: Abomination in the Slaughter Square, after the three ziggurats are cleared.

bosses.name: Baron Rivendare
bosses.description: Final boss, in the Slaughter House. Rescue Ysida Harmon by killing him within 45 minutes.

trash.name: Belt of Valor
trash.from: Patchwork Horror / Venom Belcher / Bile Spewer

trash.name: Frayed Abomination Stitching
trash.from: Patchwork Horror / Bile Spewer / Venom Belcher

dungeons.name: Scholomance
dungeons.description: The Barov family crypt on Caer Darrow, turned into the Cult of the Damned's school of necromancy. Darkmaster Gandling rules the halls; the Skeleton Key from the Barov quests opens the doors.

bosses.name: Kirtonos the Herald
bosses.description: Summoned on the porch with the Blood of Innocents (Kirtonos the Herald).

bosses.name: Jandice Barov
bosses.description: In the Hall of Secrets; splits into illusions. Drops Krastinov's Bag of Horrors.

bosses.name: Rattlegore
bosses.description: Bone golem in the Great Ossuary.

bosses.name: Marduk Blackpool
bosses.description: In the Viewing Room, together with Vectus.

bosses.name: Vectus
bosses.description: In the Viewing Room; Dawn's Gambit turns the students against him.

bosses.name: Ras Frostwhisper
bosses.description: Lich in the Barov family vault. Use the Soulbound Keepsake on him for The Lich, Ras Frostwhisper.

bosses.name: Instructor Malicia
bosses.description: One of the six bosses in the side rooms; all six must die to summon Gandling.

bosses.name: Doctor Theolen Krastinov
bosses.description: The Butcher, in the side rooms. Burn the Sarkhoff remains after killing him.

bosses.name: Lorekeeper Polkelt
bosses.description: One of the six bosses in the side rooms.

bosses.name: The Ravenian
bosses.description: One of the six bosses in the side rooms.

bosses.name: Lord Alexei Barov
bosses.description: One of the six bosses in the side rooms. Drops a Barov deed.

bosses.name: Lady Illucia Barov
bosses.description: One of the six bosses in the side rooms. Drops a Barov deed.

bosses.name: Darkmaster Gandling
bosses.description: Final boss, in the Headmaster's Study once the six side-room bosses are dead. He teleports players into the side rooms.

bosses.name: Death Knight Darkreaver
bosses.description: Summoned in Rattlegore's room in the Great Ossuary with the Divination Scryer: the spirits come first, then him. For the paladin's epic mount quest (Judgment and Redemption) and the shaman's The Darkreaver Menace.

bosses.name: Kormok
bosses.description: Summoned in Ras Frostwhisper's room with the Brazier from the Dungeon Set 2 quests: one of the four bosses that drop a piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet.

loot.name: Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet
Right Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet

trash.name: Wildheart Belt
trash.from: Spectral Researcher / Spectral Teacher / Scholomance Handler

dungeons.name: Shaper's Terrace
dungeons.description: An ancient titan facility in the northern hills of Un'Goro Crater, overlooking dinosaurs, tar pits and powerful crystals. Collect power crystals across Un'Goro and use them at the consoles inside the terrace.

bosses.name: Izha'Rel and Tor'Rel
bosses.description: Two raptors, fought together. Not elite.
